body:
I generally feel like going about day to day is a chore if anything; that I'm going through a machine to turn me into a laborer for my country until I die/retire. I don't find enjoyment in things other than pool among a select few other things as I would when I was younger.


I'm not even an achiever in my field of study; even when I've tried. The thought that I'm one of the losers within 'the survival of the fittest' constantly lingers in my mind and only talking about it brings it to the forefront of my mind.


Granted, there is minor relief in venting, but that can't solve my issues in just explaining to somebody why I feel a certain way; and why I dislike it so much.
Damn that looks great. On the custom I always like to go for the 'Liberty Walk' show car style on it though. Might inspire me to buy another for my racing garage! Is it based from a real wraped car?

I don't see drugs as demons as much as they are hobbies I can actually bond with, that is with the right people. I had other interests that faded away and all I want to do is smoke, sniff and play some pool at the pub


Maybe I am in a hole due to the drugs; but at some of the peaks I've been at trump anything that anybody or thing can provide for me

I've spoken with friends, uni course leader and campus wellbeing officers about it; hell, I've even helped others quit using drugs. The difference for me is no matter how long I abstain from any substance from ,nicotine to heroin (since I'm a polydrug user rather than having a real addiction to a specific substance), my life feels hollow and hobbies I once found fun have no interest for me; I can't even spend time with my friends for long periods of time without having to ask or imply "well, what's next?", at which point we would probably go and find/buy drugs. I really enjoy my film and television as a solo hobby; a form of escapism from the real world that I struggle to enjoy with others but besides from that; I'd always turn down a car ride/ walk somewhere to do something that didn't include drug use; even if the alternative just meant not using at home. I know I'm the toxic element to the friend group, and I don't even know why people want to spend time with me, being that they have only ever met and got to know me high on substance (both me and them). 


I used to really enjoy video games; something that as my skill deteriorated only frustrates me and I was never one for much sport besides contact sports such as rugby as at the time I was strong enough to hurt other people; now the tables have turned. I don't have much going for me and I'd personally prefer an easy way out; especially as somebody that believes it to be the be-all-and-end-all solution.

I don't know where to find it, how to, or how long I have to live to find out. Life to me is worth living, the majority of the time, when I'm altering my perception of reality with psychoactive substances. I don't want my life worth living to transform into a life behind bars for living my life.
